summary: PTY producer finalization runs only from the explicit daemon-startup hook, not when constructing a runtime for doctor or repair dry-run reads. Vanished producer reconciliation still checks exact process generation, boot identity and closed scopes before publishing closure.

schema.detail: No additional changes to native producer records or database schemas.

rules.detail: Identityless runtime construction cannot write producer closure or ownership records. Legacy scope-only records remain conservatively pending while their PID is present.

compatibility.detail: Existing owner records remain readable. The startup hook uses the same typed closure and server-generation records as native producer finalization.

downtime.detail: The explicit startup pass runs once when the daemon starts.

manual.detail: No manual producer-directory changes are required.

recovery.detail: Removing the startup hook retains pending producers rather than treating runtime construction or registry absence as closure proof.
